entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stood on the palace balcony, watc..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood on the palace balcony, watching as a flurry of monarch butterflies drifted through the air, their orange wings catching the late spring afternoon sunlight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They had come from as far as Rumbur..."
entries.dialogueText: They had come from as far as Rumburg, journeying thousands of miles to reach southern Xina, where they would winter.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rizia lay in the heart of their mig..."
entries.dialogueText: Rizia lay in the heart of their migration path.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had seen them before, but this ti..."
entries.dialogueText: I had seen them before, but this time, something about their passage struck me differently.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Perhaps it was the timing – this se..."
entries.dialogueText: Perhaps it was the timing – this season of change, of endings and beginnings.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I couldn't help but think that I, t..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't help but think that I, too, had traveled a great distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was not the man I had been when I..."
entries.dialogueText: I was not the man I had been when I first took the throne.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A knock at the door drew me from my..."
entries.dialogueText: A knock at the door drew me from my thoughts.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I thought about how the flutter of..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought about how the flutter of a butterfly's wings could send ripples through the air, unseen but far-reaching.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I couldn't stop thinking about how..."
entries.dialogueText: I couldn't stop thinking about how when butterflies land on you, they’re tasting you with their feet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "How even the smallest decisions in..."
entries.dialogueText: How even the smallest decisions in my reign -- those made in quiet moments -- could set off a chain of events far beyond my control.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As their footsteps faded down the c..."
entries.dialogueText: As their footsteps faded down the corridor, I turned my gaze to the window overlooking the garden.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sun had begun to set, and the s..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun had begun to set, and the silhouettes of butterflies fluttered against the fading light.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was once again reminded of the di..."
entries.dialogueText: I was once again reminded of the distance I had traveled to get here.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "How my journey was far from over, a..."
entries.dialogueText: How my journey was far from over, and I would see it through to the end.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was once again reminded that, lik..."
entries.dialogueText: I was once again reminded that, like the seasons, I too had changed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And my transformation would carry m..."
entries.dialogueText: And my transformation would carry me far into the future.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was once again reminded of how th..."
entries.dialogueText: I was once again reminded of how the smallest of actions could result in consequences far beyond my control.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was once again reminded that they..."
entries.dialogueText: I was once again reminded that they taste with their feet -- how life is fully of strange, unexpected oddities.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And that as King of Rizia, it was m..."
entries.dialogueText: And that as King of Rizia, it was my sole responsibility to deal with whatever came my way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And no matter how strange the journ..."
entries.dialogueText: And no matter how strange the journey ahead might be, I would face the future head-on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With no Grand Vizier to mediate bet..."
entries.dialogueText: With no Grand Vizier to mediate between me and the matters of my kingdom, I alone was responsible for reviewing them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An attendant stepped forward, head..."
entries.dialogueText: An attendant stepped forward, head bowed, holding a leather-bound folder thick with reports.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With one last glance at the butterf..."
entries.dialogueText: With one last glance at the butterflies, I stepped inside and made my way to my study.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Setting the folder down, I took out..."
entries.dialogueText: Setting the folder down, I took out the reports and spread them across my desk.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Angelica stepped forward, head bowe..."
entries.dialogueText: Angelica stepped forward, head bowed. One of her aides proffered a leather-bound folder thick with documents.

entries.dialogueText: "Ah, more paperwork. How delightful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Guess I should get this over with...."
entries.dialogueText: "Guess I should get this over with..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent. I will retire to my stu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. I will retire to my study and look this over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. You may go."

entries.dialogueText: I turned my attention to foreign affairs.

entries.dialogueText: I sat in my chair and took a moment to scan the contents, considering where to begin.
